SELECT id, canal_id, nome_canal, nicho_alvo, COALESCE(inscritos,0) AS inscritos
FROM canais_descobertos
WHERE ativo = true
ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, inscritos DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50;

=UPDATE canais_descobertos
SET inscritos = {{ $json.inscritos }},
    total_videos = {{ $json.total_videos }},
    total_views = {{ $json.total_views }},
    views_medio_aproximado = {{ $json.views_medio }},
    nome_canal = '{{ $json.nome_canal_real }}',
    canal_id = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.canal_id_real }}' <> '' AND '{{ $json.canal_id_real }}' <> canal_id
                    THEN '{{ $json.canal_id_real }}' ELSE canal_id END,
    data_ultima_analise = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE canal_id = '{{ $json.canal_id_anterior }}'
RETURNING canal_id;

=INSERT INTO videos_pendentes (
  plataforma, canal_id, video_id, url_video, titulo_original,
  descricao_original, thumbnail_url, duracao_segundos,
  views, likes, comentarios, engagement_pct, nicho, status
) VALUES (
  'youtube',
  '{{ $json.canal_id }}',
  '{{ $json.video_id }}',
  '{{ $json.url_video }}',
  '{{ $json.titulo_original }}',
  '{{ $json.descricao_original }}',
  '{{ $json.thumbnail_url }}',
  {{ $json.duracao_segundos }},
  {{ $json.views }},
  {{ $json.likes }},
  {{ $json.comentarios }},
  {{ $json.engagement_pct }},
  '{{ $json.nicho }}',
  'pendente'
)
ON CONFLICT (video_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
